fixed: bounded early native inbox and shutdown fencing
cancellable manifest hashing and engine probes
bounded progress and stale attempt guards
async GUI registration and fixture order
safe public error categories and shared contract
PDF identity independent of unrelated engine readiness
review.intermediateReportNote: Includes the preserved Svelte failure; svelte.txt records its successful correction.

limits: Common bundled-resource integrity failures remain fail-closed for the entire bundle
Legacy internal String errors are gradually classified, not comprehensively rewritten
Old development PDF fingerprints may conservatively re-export partial tasks without overwriting old files
Kernel-blocked filesystem IO is not forcibly interrupted by cancellation checks
